findings: All 13 were found in the game data with exact positions, each within 33 m of a MapGenie constellation point. The positions were not preserved.
The MapGenie name order is the same as the order of the game's mission and knowledge keys.
Each constellation has a challenge mission named Challenge_Anamorphic_<Name>, at state 2 in every current save.
Each constellation has two knowledge entries, and none of the current saves contain them.
No native map icon template exists for constellations, so an existing icon must be reused (the user chooses which).
hypothesis: The mission moves to state 5 when the constellation is completed, since other finished missions sit at 5. Unconfirmed: no constellation is done in any save.
